builds.exp230: first build with gateway routes; installed on the three nodes and replaced the same day, never published (see incident)

what_since_exp229: Gateway routes: a package ships /usr/share/qsm-pve-direct-gateway/routes.d/ID.json (administrator: /etc/qsm-pve-direct/gateway-routes.d/), and https://NODE:8006/PREFIX/ reaches that node service on 127.0.0.1, verified against the cluster CA. Reserved prefixes and the gateway's own ports are refused; a bad file is skipped. A dpkg trigger and the refresh action apply a change with an HAProxy reload, never a pveproxy restart; prepare applies it at every gateway start.
exp231: a route change edits only the route lines of the installed haproxy.cfg; everything else stays byte for byte. enable still renders a fresh file.
APT: a QSM release may carry pve-ui-overlays, qdev-host and qdev-host-pve with their own versions.

Through the gateway: VM 104 popup 2/2 (first video 2354 and 884 ms), embedded + window; qdev-host panel requests only to /qdev-host/ (2 same-origin, 0 to port 8017); add and remove on VM 104.

qdev-host refused VM 105 (dbus-display unreadable by stock qemu-server) and VM 104 without snippets storage with 422 before any change. The first build had added the root port to VM 105's args and failed with an internal error, and qm set dropped VM 105's dbus-display line; both found here, VM 105 restored, code fixed.
Gateway disable and enable: enable put the route into the fresh config.
The lab was returned to its original state (qsm 0.4.0+shared3, patched pve-manager, no gateway, no qdev-host) and stopped.

10.30.0.240.incident: exp230's refresh rendered haproxy.cfg from its template and dropped the eight hand-added bind lines; from 13:55:04 to 13:55:48 CET PVE took no new connections on those addresses. Restored by hand (previous file plus route lines), then fixed in exp231, whose upgrade, prepare and refresh left the file byte for byte unchanged. The fix was checked against this node's file in both directions.

findings: The gateway's haproxy.cfg is a file administrators edit after enable; tools must not re-render it. Fixed in exp231.
qm set writes back only the settings the installed qemu-server parsed; a tool that edits a VM must refuse configs with unparsable keys. qdev-host 0.4.0 does.
qm config also prints warnings of storage plugins; only lines 'vm VMID - unable to parse value of' describe the VM.
A node without /etc/pve/storage.cfg uses PVE's default storage, which has no snippets content.
not_checked: No QSM console of 10.30.0.240 opened after the update: its only QSM container was in use.
Long sessions; only popup and embedded runs.
A gateway node behind real NAT from outside; all browser checks ran from inside the networks.
